QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_29

question.text: Chapter 12 notes several Indian AIFs are aligning with international reporting standards. Which of the following is NOT among the standard-setters mentioned in the chapter?

answer.text: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) by CFA Institute.
International Private Equity and Venture Capital (IPEV) Valuation Board.
International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) standards for UCITS.

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 289 of XIX-D names four reporting/valuation standards: GIPS (CFA Institute), ILPA, the IPEV Valuation Board, and EVCA standard practices. IOSCO standards for UCITS are not in that list. The Trap: GIPS, ILPA, and IPEV are all expressly named on page 289, so they cannot be the exception. IOSCO/UCITS is a plausible-sounding distractor but is not among the listed standards. Note: The pages checked do not characterise IOSCO UCITS as an AIF standard or recommend specific ILPA template adoption; the answer rests on the named list on page 289.
